Show less Read more Like 15 Dislike Reply @SnakeAndTurtleQigong 4 years ago Sending gratitude from a Daoist monastery near Seattle! ️ Show less Read more Like 1 Dislike Reply @madrededeus 4 years ago “Power never takes a back step – only in the face of more power. ” Malcolm X Show less Read more Like 4 Dislike Reply Comments 297 Top Show featured comments Newest Show recent comments, including potential spam In this video Transcript Description The secret to effective nonviolent resistance | Jamila Raqib 5.3KLikes195,173Views2016Jul 7 We're not going to end violence by telling people that it's morally wrong, says Jamila Raqib, executive director of the Albert Einstein Institution. Instead, we must find alternative ways to conduct conflict that are equally powerful and effective. Raqib promotes nonviolent resistance to people living under tyranny -- and there's a lot more to it than street protests. She shares encouraging examples of creative strategies that have led to change around the world and a message of hope for a future without armed conflict. "The greatest hope for humanity lies not in condemning violence but in making violence obsolete," Raqib says.
